ios.desc:
Pasta builds a workout or plan for you.

Hold to talk ("Let's work on legs today") and let go. You get a full session: exercises, sets, reps, rest. Don't like the lunges? Say so and Pasta swaps them. Found a workout on YouTube or on a web page? Paste the link and Pasta tries its best to turn it into a session.

WHILE YOU TRAIN
Voice guidance during your workout, on every set and rest. Timers work on Live Activity as well as home screen Widgets. Check your heart rate using Apple Watch or any supported Bluetooth heart rate monitor.

PLANS
Tell Pasta what you're training for. "A half marathon in December" or "a Hyrox event in 6 weeks". It plans selected workouts around days you can train. Use Personal Context or connect Apple Health for more personalized plans.

PROGRESS
Workouts save to Apple Health and count toward your rings. Insights shows heart-rate zones, active minutes and training load, plus a readiness check from your latest HRV.

SIRI
Say "Create workouts on Pasta", or ask what's on today or whether you're ready to train. Siri answers out loud, card included.

PRIVACY
No account. No ads. No tracking. Apple Intelligence builds your workouts on your iPhone, and everything you track stays on your device.

REQUIREMENT
Requires an iPhone with Apple Intelligence (iPhone 15 Pro or newer).

WHY PASTA?
Al dente means "to the tooth". Firm, with a bit of resistance. That's the whole idea. Also, you've earned a plate after leg day.

MEMBERSHIP
The first 7 days are free. Then $9.99 a month, $99 a year, or $299 once. Prices vary by country. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your Apple Account settings.

quotes.text:
Hi Hacker News! I'm Tim, and I made y'all some Pasta. :)

Others have New Year's resolutions to get fit, mine's to build an app in hopes of getting fit.

Fun fact, I built something like this over 10 years ago but never released it. Co-founder issues, if you must know. I called it Träna Fit, träna being the Swedish word for train. I remember hiring a voice actor on Fiverr to record every rep count.

Fast forward to today and the models are good enough to do much of this, and more. Pasta is a personal trainer app for iPhone. You ask for a workout by voice or text, Apple's Foundation Models build it, and a small voice model running on the phone (Kokoro-82M) guides you as you train.

When it comes to planning and generation, I have to admit it still has plenty of room for improvement. I grade what it writes with evals. My favorite catch so far: I asked for a 500 kg deadlift for 100 reps, and the model built it, no questions asked. I'm hoping to make the evals better as I get more feedback on what's working and what's not. Over time, I'd like it to come as close as possible to what a certified personal trainer would build for you based on your goals and needs.

I also realize that getting fit and working out isn't solely about knowing what to do. There's also the motivation + accountability part, and I do have some ideas on the roadmap that I'll share later. And I swear, it's not gamifying your health and fitness results.
